### Stepping Out in Faith
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-31-2024.html
Passage: Hebrews 11:8
Points:
- Abraham serves as the supreme biblical pattern of trusting God and putting faith into immediate action.
- God called Abraham to abandon familiar security and comforts, armed solely with divine promises.
- True faith steps forward in obedience without demanding complete advance knowledge of the final destination.
- Refusing God's call to go forward inevitably leads to spiritual stagnation and backward drift.
- Stepping out in obedience places the believer squarely inside God's redemptive purpose and blessing.

### What Lies Beneath Longings?
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-november-11-2011.html
Passage: Hebrews 11:16
Points:
- Aches of loneliness, homesickness, and yearning for past comforts are common human experiences.
- Deep beneath unmet earthly desires lies a God-given hunger to be at home in His presence.
- Scripture reminds believers that they are only temporary visitors rather than permanent earthly residents.
- Life in this world must be lived purposefully, focused on loving and serving God and neighbors.
- Everyday moments of nostalgia can serve as signposts pointing gratefully toward our heavenly home.
